## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm validate:data` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] New or changed dataset JSON validates against the schema and tag vocabulary.
- [ ] Cover is 16:9, WebP, under 2 MB, with a matching thumbnail (or no cover is supplied).
- [ ] License and redistribution rights are checked.
- [ ] All three privacy answers are present.
- [ ] Links work without private credentials.
- [ ] Any substantive dataset change has a `history` entry.
- [ ] Both English and Chinese text are provided where practical; missing translations are intentional.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private personal data or large data archives are committed.
